anyOf.description: The command that started the run: ask, research, do, or run (a saved workflow).

title.description: Document title, else the intent or query, else the workflow name.

status.description: The manifest status as the CLI prints it.

anyOf.description: Whether the task was done: fulfilled (every declared requirement met), partial (a result was saved but a requirement is unmet or no contract was declared), handoff (the run needs the user), failed (nothing usable was saved), or aborted (the user interrupted).

task_outcome.description: Whether the task was done: fulfilled (every declared requirement met), partial (a result was saved but a requirement is unmet or no contract was declared), handoff (the run needs the user), failed (nothing usable was saved), or aborted (the user interrupted).

anyOf.description: Why the run stopped: stalled (no progress after recovery), turn-timeout (thinking limit), the model finished, a budget or the repeated-failure breaker ended it, a handoff was raised, the user aborted, or the provider failed. wall-clock-soft means the model finished after the exploration wind-down began. owner_lost means the process that owned the run died before writing a terminal result, and a reconciler recorded the end (FEAT-064). Added in FEAT-063: readable by new executables only.

termination_reason.description: Why the run stopped: stalled (no progress after recovery), turn-timeout (thinking limit), the model finished, a budget or the repeated-failure breaker ended it, a handoff was raised, the user aborted, or the provider failed. wall-clock-soft means the model finished after the exploration wind-down began. owner_lost means the process that owned the run died before writing a terminal result, and a reconciler recorded the end (FEAT-064). Added in FEAT-063: readable by new executables only.

anyOf.description: Set only by the reconciler when the owning process died before writing a terminal result (plan D7). Separate from the outcome, which follows the evidence and is never `aborted`. Absent for every run that ended on its own.

execution_state.description: Set only by the reconciler when the owning process died before writing a terminal result (plan D7). Separate from the outcome, which follows the evidence and is never `aborted`. Absent for every run that ended on its own.

live.description: Present only while the run has not ended; unknown_owner when its owner cannot be verified.

id.description: Run-wide action identifier, equal to A followed by the ledger sequence.

label.description: Sanitized field or control label; null when no label is known.

label_origin.description: Evidence from which the fill label was resolved.

section.description: Sanitized form section containing the field.

epoch.description: Committed document epoch when the action happened.

call_id.description: Provider tool-call identifier, or null for a direct execution.

host.description: Page hostname at action time, or null when unknown.

reason.description: Why the readback was withheld, including an opaque stored-secret fill.

verdict.description: Safe comparison verdict; never the protected value.

verification.description: Fill verification without any committed value.

signal.description: Signal that caused a submit refusal.

kind.description: What kind of file the artifact is.

path.description: Run-relative path of the artifact file, using forward slashes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

sent_to_model.description: True only when the image was shown to the model provider (Vision Assist); false for a capture kept on this computer.

items.description: One file a tool call wrote to the run directory: metadata only, never image bytes or a data URI.

artifacts.description: Every saved file of a capture action.

items.description: One cited, verified browser action: identities and verdicts only, never field values.

actions.description: Cited action evidence, in first-citation order; absent on older Briefs.

schema_version.description: Protocol schema version this document was written under.

overview.description: Answer-first Markdown synthesis (1-3 paragraphs) with inline [n] citations.

actions.description: Recorded action IDs backing this content.

text.description: Markdown text of the finding. Inline [n] markers are optional: the LLM path may emit them, while the deterministic path carries citations only in the structured citations[] array. The structured array is the single source of truth for rendering.

citations.description: Source numbers (sources[].n) backing this finding. At least one is required unless editorial is true.

editorial.description: True marks uncited synthesis commentary — the only legal uncited form.

facet.description: Optional structured payload (for example { price: 328, in_stock: true }), or null.

text.description: Markdown text of a nested child finding.

citations.description: Source numbers (sources[].n) backing this child finding; at least one is required.

items.description: A one-level nested finding under a key finding.

children.description: Nested child findings that elaborate this parent; one level deep only.

actions.description: Recorded action IDs backing this content.

kind.description: Labels off-contract alternatives; absent for ordinary sections.

body_md.description: Markdown body prose; must not contain raw ANSI escapes.

citations.description: Source numbers (sources[].n) cited by this section.

items.description: A deep-detail prose section of the Brief.

sections.description: Deep-detail sections; empty at the overview synthesis budget.

row_actions.description: Recorded action IDs backing each row, in row order.

rows.description: Comparison rows; every row length must equal columns.length.

row_citations.description: Sources backing each row, in row order; length must equal rows.length.

comparison.description: Tabular comparison data, or null when the query has no comparative shape.

facets.description: Structured/tabular facets, or null when the query has no comparative shape.

cited.description: True for evidence cited by the answer; false for consulted-only sources. All-or-none across sources.

n.description: Citation number; contiguous 1..N in array order.

final_url.description: Post-redirect landing URL, or null when no redirect was observed.

title.description: Page title, or null when unavailable.

excerpt.description: Short extracted snippet of the source content, or null when not captured.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 publication timestamp, or null when unknown.

name.description: Condition name from the task contract.

status.description: Whether the condition is confirmed, unknown, or not met.

citations.description: Evidence backing the status; verified requires at least one source.

items.description: A declared condition and its evidence-backed delivery status.

constraints.description: Declared conditions and their delivery statuses; absent on older artifacts.

id.description: Requirement id: deliverable, filter:<name>, fill, artifact:screenshot:<scope>, or effects.submit.

status.description: Whether evidence shows the requirement met, unmet, or not applicable.

reason.description: What the evidence showed, or null when nothing needs saying.

declared_in.description: The contract revision that declared the requirement, or null when not tracked.

reason.description: Why the engine left a form control out of "fill every eligible field".

items.description: A form control the engine left out of "fill every eligible field".

exemptions.description: Controls the engine judged exempt from the fill requirement.

exempt_overflow.description: How many more exempt controls exist beyond the listed ones.

items.description: One declared requirement of the task contract and its evidence-judged status.

requirements.description: Each declared requirement of a do task and its evidence-judged status; absent on older artifacts and on ask and research Briefs.

scope.description: What a screenshot covers: the visible viewport, the full page, or one element.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

part.description: 1-based position of this file in its capture set.

parts.description: How many files the capture set holds.

complete.description: False when the set was clipped or truncated and does not show the whole target.

items.description: A label on a capture set: clipped_width, truncated, or beyond_viewport.
One saved capture file the run produced, linked relative to the run directory.

artifacts.description: Saved capture files of a do task, one entry per file in capture order; absent on older artifacts and on ask and research Briefs.

search_provider.description: Search provider that produced the source candidates, or null.

synthesis.description: Synthesis strategy that produced the Brief.

deterministic_fallback_used.description: True when the LLM path failed and the deterministic synthesizer took over.

coverage.description: Fraction of fetched sources represented in the Brief (0-1), or null.

freshness.description: Human-readable freshness signal (for example "today"), or null.

claims_checked.description: Claims inspected by the citation-faithfulness validator.

citation_verdict.description: Citation-faithfulness verdict (filled post-synthesis), or null before validation.

usage.description: LLM usage totals, or null on the deterministic path.

candidate_claims.description: Claim candidates considered before the eligibility gates.

accepted_claims.description: Claims that passed the eligibility gates and reached the Brief.

excluded_sources.description: Sources dropped by the query-relevance gate before assembly.

evidence.description: Evidence-selection counts from the deterministic pipeline (candidate vs accepted claims, excluded sources), or null on the LLM path.

run_id.description: Owning run id, or null outside a run context.

source.description: Host or subsystem the notice concerns.

kind.description: Notice classification. `contract_gap` marks a part of the declared task contract not delivered, a condition not confirmed or not met, or rows shown as alternatives because they do not come from a required source. `source_excluded` marks a source dropped as irrelevant to the query before assembly; `limited_evidence` marks a Brief that fell short of the requested length because too few relevant findings survived the evidence gates; `search_failed` marks web searches that failed during the run, grouped by stable failure code (source `search:<provider>`); `budget_exhausted` marks a run budget (navigations, hosts) that Yantra itself imposed running out, never a site refusing access.

items.description: An honest per-source failure or validator flag.

notices.description: Honest per-source failures and validator flags; may be empty.

value.description: The universal synthesized output document: answer-first overview, key findings, sections, facets, numbered sources, notices, and metadata. Every citation resolves to a declared source (no uncited claims).

detail.description: A bounded parse or validation summary; never file content.

found_version.description: The schema_version the file declares, e.g. `0.1`.

slot.description: One artifact: ok with its value, or missing, corrupt, unsupported, too large or denied.

template.description: Template identity and content hash recorded with a rendered report.

title.description: Display title used by history and HTML.

rendered_md.description: Canonical Markdown rendered by the runtime.

metadata.description: Reused Brief provenance and usage metadata.

value.description: A runtime-rendered report backed by a user-authored Markdown template.

detail.description: A bounded parse or validation summary; never file content.

found_version.description: The schema_version the file declares, e.g. `0.1`.

slot.description: One artifact: ok with its value, or missing, corrupt, unsupported, too large or denied.

document.description: The Brief or templated document, or none.

detail.description: A bounded parse or validation summary; never file content.

found_version.description: The schema_version the file declares, e.g. `0.1`.

anyOf.description: One artifact: ok with its value, or missing, corrupt, unsupported, too large or denied.

outputs.description: A workflow run’s outputs.json; null for other runs.

source.description: Which reader answered: the run-event stream, manifest, events.jsonl or report.md.

blocker.description: What blocked the run, for a handoff.

safest_next_action.description: The one next step the run recorded.

termination_reason.description: Why the run stopped: stalled (no progress after recovery), turn-timeout (thinking limit), the model finished, a budget or the repeated-failure breaker ended it, a handoff was raised, the user aborted, or the provider failed. wall-clock-soft means the model finished after the exploration wind-down began. owner_lost means the process that owned the run died before writing a terminal result, and a reconciler recorded the end (FEAT-064). Added in FEAT-063: readable by new executables only.

anyOf.description: Why the run ended; every text bounded to 500 characters.

terminal.description: Why the run ended; every text bounded to 500 characters.

failed_by_code.description: Failed searches by stable failure code.

providers.description: Distinct search providers used, in first-use order.

breaker_skipped.description: Searches refused without a provider call because an earlier challenge opened the search breaker (FEAT-050).

peak_concurrency.description: Most provider searches in flight at once (FEAT-050).

http.description: Pages served by the HTTP tier.

browser.description: Pages served by a browser render.

by_mode.description: Network fetches by how they were served.

repeat_fetches.description: Network fetches of a normalized URL already fetched earlier in the run.

failed_by_code.description: Failed `web_fetch` calls by stable error code.

cache_hits.description: Reads answered from the run document store with no network fetch (FEAT-050).

memo_hits.description: Reads answered from the remembered terminal failure of an earlier read (FEAT-050).

http.description: Human-verification pages served to the HTTP tier.

browser.description: Human-verification pages served to the browser render.

extract.description: Per-site pages fetched but not readable.

blocked.description: Per-site ethics refusals (robots, blocklist, rate limit).

budget.description: Page reads skipped by the run's own navigation/host budget (web_search sites and web_fetch calls).

policy.description: Per-site reads refused by the run's own URL policy.

source_failures.description: Per-site read failures inside multi-source tools, by stage.

pool_launches.description: Launches of the run's shared background page pool (FEAT-050).

contexts.description: Isolated browser contexts the page pool opened, one per background page (FEAT-050).

exhausted.description: Budget limits that refused at least one call, in first-hit order.

total.description: Tool calls that ended in error or timeout.

by_code.description: Failed tool calls by stable error code.

mode.description: Whether stall and thinking limits are enforced.

progress_error.description: Progress tracking failed open to observe mode.

items.description: Live contract items without labels or identities.

fill.description: Fill coverage, or null without inventory.

steer_idle.description: Steers held for the next prompt.

turn_limit_aborts.description: Thinking phases aborted at the limit.

progress.description: Semantic progress, recovery and turn telemetry; absent on older runs.

notices.description: Runtime-derived notices attached to the published document; 0 when nothing was published.

pages_by_shape.description: Shape-aware page reads returned to the model, by page shape.

records_shown.description: Collection records shown to the model.

links_offered.description: Links offered to the model (byte-identical after sanitizing).

links_withheld.description: Links withheld because the model-visible transform would have altered them.

discovered_follows.description: Successful web_fetch and browser_navigate calls to a URL a read page offered.

extraction.description: Shape-aware extraction (FEAT-051): pages by shape, records, and links.

available.description: Whether the capability is registered for this run.

items.description: A condition that keeps Vision Assist off.

reasons.description: Every condition that keeps it off; empty exactly when available.

vision_assist.description: Whether Vision Assist (screenshots sent to the model) is available, and why not.

available.description: Whether the capability is registered for this run.

items.description: A condition that keeps deliverable capture off.

reasons.description: Every condition that keeps it off; empty exactly when available.

deliverable.description: Whether deliverable capture (screenshots kept on this computer) is available, and why not.

capture.description: Both capture capabilities with reason codes, and what deliverable capture wrote (FEAT-058).

value.description: An agentic run's own health summary (run-health.json): searches, fetches, source failures, browser launches, budgets, tool failures, and runtime notices. Counts and closed codes only.

detail.description: A bounded parse or validation summary; never file content.

found_version.description: The schema_version the file declares, e.g. `0.1`.

run_health.description: One artifact: ok with its value, or missing, corrupt, unsupported, too large or denied.

report.description: report.md; its body is read lazily through read.report.

exposure.description: typed: only through a typed read (e.g. brief.json through read.run_result); view: through a bounded viewer; download: only as an attachment; denied: never served.

viewer.description: The bounded viewer that opens the file; `none` when no viewer exists.

over_inline_cap.description: Larger than its viewer loads whole.

notices_source.description: Where the Notices block comes from.

RunResultView.description: One run, read for the app’s Run result page.
